hooks.command: R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; S="$R/subtasks/target/release/subtask"; L="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/xstack-build.log"; if [ -x "$S" ] && "$S" hot; then :; else (cargo build --release --manifest-path "$R/worker/Cargo.toml" && cargo build --release --manifest-path "$R/subtasks/Cargo.toml") </dev/null >"$L" 2>&1 & echo "SUBTASK BUILDING in the background (log $L). Run $S hot before the first fan-out; until it prints SUBTASK HOT, run mechanical work directly."; fi
